thresholds.registered: 2026-10-20, before any v2 frame was generated
thresholds.auc_definition: two-sided ROC AUC, max(AUC, 1 - AUC); val clean versions (1,496) vs val glared versions (1,496)

darkest_pixel.reason: v1's constant floor made min pixel a perfect classifier. Veiling glare really does lift the blacks, so the darkest pixels may carry some signal, but no more than plain brightness does.

single_feature.noise_level_reason: Shot-noise variance grows with signal (variance = a * signal + b). Glared frames carry more light, so they genuinely carry more noise, as a real sensor would. That allows a small excess over 0.60. Above 0.65 the separation comes from our noise model, not physics.

mild_band_brightness.scope: pass/fail on the mild band only: val glared frames in the mild band vs their paired clean versions. The all-frames AUC is reported with no pass/fail.
mild_band_brightness.midtone_histogram_scoring: logistic regression on the 16 bins, trained on the train split (all bands); AUC of its scores on val
mild_band_brightness.reason: Glare adds light and auto-exposure only partly compensates, and veiling glare pushes shadows into the midtones, so across all severities these two probes measure the glare itself. Mild glare should barely register; if these separate mild frames, something other than the glare is doing it.
mild_band_brightness.changed: 2026-10-20, before generation: moved from single_feature (all frames, <= 0.60) to the mild band only
mild_band_brightness.status_reason: The mild severity band was dropped after calibration (results/severity_scale_decision.json, commit ddf2673), so there are no mild frames to evaluate. Marked 2026-10-20; the registered limit is kept for the record.

brightness_removed_lr.reason: With every brightness feature removed, only artifacts are left. A classifier on artifacts alone must stay near chance.

mild_vs_severe.model: logistic regression on the gate classifier's 9 features (src/train_gate_classifier.py), trained on the train split
mild_vs_severe.band_accuracy: accuracy on val glared frames in the band plus their paired clean frames (balanced 50/50)
mild_vs_severe.reason: Mild glare barely changes the frame. If mild frames are as easy to spot as severe ones, something other than the glare gives them away.
mild_vs_severe.status_reason: The mild severity band was dropped after calibration (results/severity_scale_decision.json, commit ddf2673), so there are no mild frames to evaluate. Marked 2026-10-20; the registered limit is kept for the record.

determinism.rule: re-rendering val frames gives sha256-identical JPEGs to data/glare_v2_sha256.txt

v1_reference.note: v1 is unpaired: 748 glared IDs vs 748 different clean IDs
